● Comfortably set 3 teams for Real-Time Arena & at least 4 teams for Total War
● Whether or not you wish to climb the Arena ladder is your personal preference but endgame PVP would mean fighting with all properly rolled gears, maxed potential pets. 
If you are a speed team player, aim for 440-450 speed. If you are a tank team player, then the aim would be to go for stats via transcendence.

column17:
Free FIRST MULTI (Re-roll Potential):
● Ruri is the best choice with high early-game usage. Even though she becomes outclassed by Nezha subsequently, but is still essential in endgame Advent Expedition.
The rest have way less usage frequency, in terms of utility,
● Velika is the 2nd best choice, very helpful for several Infinite Tower floors, until you have much stronger heroes, and for Tower of Trials (monthly/bimonthly). 
● Bidam, as 3rd choice, helps in Dark Power-Up Dungeon and in Advent Expedition. However, he is far more RNG-reliant due to Bleed and can be less consistent.
The last two options have very limited uses.
● Yu Shin helps with Adventure and Tower clears in early game but doesn't have much use case beyond, especially after getting stronger heroes with more team synergy.
● Nia is more PVP-oriented (specifically Real-Time Arena & Lower Tier Arena/GW) and more suitable for endgame. She also requires very stacked Speed gears to do well in those areas.

Welcome Wish List Summon (AFTER FIRST 10 SUMMONS - 14 DAYS ONLY 300 TICKETS):
A Free Wish List banner for New Players only, with a restricted choice of L+ and L heroes. Game also gives up to 300 Hero Summon Vouchers during the first 14 days allowing 3 full pities.

● The best L+ picks would be Lu Bu/Freyja. Lu Bu works at T0 while Freyja works at T2 for farming. (Note: you may NOT get 3 copies of Freyja).
● The best L pick would be Daisy. She is an essential Raid staple but there are no ways to get her for free. So this is one possible way to gamble for her. Other options include Taka or Lina (if F2P).
● The best R picks would be the ones which should be T6 as soon as possible and they would be your Raid heroes. If you have missing essential R heroes (refer below), feel free to swap them in and out of the wish list.

Kyle Beginner Fixed Banner (AFTER FIRST 10 SUMMONS):
● Kyle is a powerful damage dealer that can help in clearing adventure stages with ease. The banner was updated at a time where Kyle overtook Teo as the best farmer in the game but it would seem that there are better options currently.
● Seeing that Lu Bu is available in the Welcome Wish List Summon, this makes Kyle less worth using rubies to summon for especially in the early stages where ruby farming isn't at its more optimal and efficient level.

column2:
FREE FARMER

Rei is given for free and being a double 5-Target AOE CC unit, she can efficiently help to push adventure as the main DPS at the beginning.
column19:
3-TARGET FARMERS

The 1st map (X-1) only has 3 enemies per phase, making it possible for newer players to start off using these heroes.

column2:
LOW INVESTMENT FARMERS

These farmers work even at T0 allowing newer players to farm better in higher stages. Lu Bu is a hero that gets better with each Transcendence significantly.
column19:
T2 FARMERS

These farmers have better efficiency upon reaching T2. Some have to be T2. Freyja does become one of the best farmers in the game despite this necessity.
column34:
T6 FARMER

Definitely not something you can achieve as a new player so soon but O'Mok is the strongest and fastest farmer in the game, able to kill all enemies with just 1 skill.
